author: Tobias Russell, opinion contributor
description: Geothermal energy offers a politically neutral solution to America's power needs, yet its potential growth is being hindered by slow federal permitting processes.
title: No more red energy, blue energy. Geothermal is purple — and Washington is delaying it.
